reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: The best college for a technical course.

review_content.Placements: In my course, mostly 70% of students get placement. The highest package offered is 21 LPA, and the average package is 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Zomato, Microsoft, Wipro, and LinkedIn. Top roles offered by the companies are telecalling, web development, data analysis, and purchase assistance.
review_content.Infrastructure: College infrastructure is so good, there are clean classes, well-hygiene washrooms, and an RO water service facility. There is Wi-Fi available in all classes, and the seminar halls are wide and have enough space for 200 students to be seated at once. Also, there are clean corridors.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Good in infrastructure, syllabus, and they conduct excellent training every semester.

review_content.Placements: Well, it's better not to hope for even a single percent from this college, as barely anyone gets selected on campus because barely any companies come, and even if they do, they pay too little. There is no such top recruiting company. If I named them, everybody would say they have heard about this company for the first time, and it’s too hard to find them on Google, too. The top role offered in my course is web development.
review_content.Infrastructure: Well, I will say that in terms of infrastructure, this is the best. It's so goated that multiple movies, web series, and ads are being shot here. Classrooms are well-equipped with centralized AC, smart boards, speakers, and Wi-Fi. The library is also well-spaced and has a lot of books and quite a space to study. The hostel is also the best according to infrastructure, and the mess food, I would say, is okayish. Hostels have good Wi-Fi and hot and cold showers, and a sports ground.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: It is an excellent college with good and experienced faculty members.

review_content.Placements: Placement support is decent. The placement cell brings companies with a reasonable profit range, and strong performers take good offers. The average package offered is aligned with industry standards. The top packages offered depend highly on our preparation. Workshops and mock interviews are the best.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college has good infrastructure with greenery. The size of the campus is very large. Hostels are also available that are separate for both boys and girls. Wi-Fi connectivity is also available, but it is only in the academic block and is weaker in hostels. The overall ecosystem promotes focused learning.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) (Lateral Entry) - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: The perfect hub of technology .

review_content.Placements: I'm pursuing B.Tech, and the academics are so good that most of the students get placement from campus. There are around 80 percent of students who get placement from the campus. The highest package is 50 LPA in my course. The top recruiting companies of my course are Google, Wipro, Accenture, Yahoo, Zomato, Swiggy, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is overall good for Students. Our department has well-equipped labs, working project tools, smart classrooms, Wi-Fi access, and a decent library with enough books for reference. The hostel facilities are also satisfactory with clean rooms, drinking water, and proper security.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: One of the best budget-friendly colleges, with job opportunities, and a great environment.

review_content.Placements: One of the best campuses in Haryana to pursue B.Tech. Healthy environment and good jobs. The placement scenario for the CSE branch here is excellent. In our batch, I would say around 85-90 percent of students who sat for placements got placed. The college's placement cell works tirelessly from the third year itself. The salary packages are very encouraging. The highest package went to a remarkable 50.5 LPA (an exceptional off-campus placement), while the lowest is around 3.5 LPA. The average package for our CSE branch is comfortable between 5.5 LPA and 6 LPA, which is a fantastic start. Top recruiting companies visit our college.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: College infrastructure and facility.

review_content.Placements: Echelon Institute of Technology gives placement opportunities equally but some students start on startup and joint family business that's why 100% students do not apply for job placement successfully. Approximately 30-35 students are placed. Roles offered are cell executive, business developer, business manager, and HR marketing.
review_content.Infrastructure: Echloan Institute of Technology in its first structure is very good whole campus is under CCTV surveillance. We have smart classrooms with centralise AC and free Wi-Fi service. Sports ground, basketball ground, cricket ground, and medical room are also available 24X7. Ambulance service is available. Gym facilities are also available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Good in infrastructure, syllabus, and they conduct excellent training every semester.

content.Placements: Well, it's better not to hope for even a single percent from this college, as barely anyone gets selected on campus because barely any companies come, and even if they do, they pay too little. There is no such top recruiting company. If I named them, everybody would say they have heard about this company for the first time, and it’s too hard to find them on Google, too. The top role offered in my course is web development.
content.Infrastructure: Well, I will say that in terms of infrastructure, this is the best. It's so goated that multiple movies, web series, and ads are being shot here. Classrooms are well-equipped with centralized AC, smart boards, speakers, and Wi-Fi. The library is also well-spaced and has a lot of books and quite a space to study. The hostel is also the best according to infrastructure, and the mess food, I would say, is okayish. Hostels have good Wi-Fi and hot and cold showers, and a sports ground.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It is an excellent college with good and experienced faculty members.

content.Placements: Placement support is decent. The placement cell brings companies with a reasonable profit range, and strong performers take good offers. The average package offered is aligned with industry standards. The top packages offered depend highly on our preparation. Workshops and mock interviews are the best.
content.Infrastructure: The college has good infrastructure with greenery. The size of the campus is very large. Hostels are also available that are separate for both boys and girls. Wi-Fi connectivity is also available, but it is only in the academic block and is weaker in hostels. The overall ecosystem promotes focused learning.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) (Lateral Entry) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The perfect hub of technology .

content.Placements: I'm pursuing B.Tech, and the academics are so good that most of the students get placement from campus. There are around 80 percent of students who get placement from the campus. The highest package is 50 LPA in my course. The top recruiting companies of my course are Google, Wipro, Accenture, Yahoo, Zomato, Swiggy, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The college infrastructure is overall good for Students. Our department has well-equipped labs, working project tools, smart classrooms, Wi-Fi access, and a decent library with enough books for reference. The hostel facilities are also satisfactory with clean rooms, drinking water, and proper security.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: One of the best budget-friendly colleges, with job opportunities, and a great environment.

content.Placements: One of the best campuses in Haryana to pursue B.Tech. Healthy environment and good jobs. The placement scenario for the CSE branch here is excellent. In our batch, I would say around 85-90 percent of students who sat for placements got placed. The college's placement cell works tirelessly from the third year itself. The salary packages are very encouraging. The highest package went to a remarkable 50.5 LPA (an exceptional off-campus placement), while the lowest is around 3.5 LPA. The average package for our CSE branch is comfortable between 5.5 LPA and 6 LPA, which is a fantastic start. Top recruiting companies visit our college.

review_summary.college_name: Justice K S Hegde Institute of Management Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Human Resources Management (Leadership Talent Management) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Review of Justice K S Hegde Institute of Management.

content.Placements: Our college is one of the best colleges for on-campus placements. The college has a developed and actively working placements cell. Almost 60% of the students get placements in our course. The average package offered in the college was 4-9 LPA. Top recruiters were Infosys, Tech Mahindra, Flipkart, HUL, etc.
content.Infrastructure: This college has very well-maintained and fully developed infrastructure. All types of necessary facilities are given to the students here in our college. The college provides facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, library, canteen, hostel, etc., to its students. All these facilities are of good quality. Sports facilities are also available for the students.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Operations Management - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied since we get theoretical knowledge clubbed with practical exposure to business field.

content.Placements: Among 170+ students for the academic year 2019-20, 85% of the eligible candidates are placed across specializations like Finance, Marketing, HR and Banking services. The highest package is 12 LPA, the lowest package is 5 LPA and the average package is 6 LPA. Top recruiters were Deloitte Consulting, Grant Thornton, KPMG and South Indian Bank. Around 50% of students have earned internships. Top roles offered during the placements were Supervisor, Executive and Analysts.
content.Infrastructure: The lush green campus at Nitte (An interior place between Karkala and Bangalore). World class infrastructure and full-fledged classrooms equipped with projectors. AC equipped Auditorium with seating capacity for more than 400 audiences. Free Wi-Fi access to all the students. Library with a subscription to more than 77000 national and international books and journals. Bloomberg Finance Lab for research and analysis. Clean and tidy hostel rooms separately for boys and girls with a quality food round the clock. Wi-Fi access to all the residents in the hostel. Canteen facility inside the institute for quick food and drink. BC Alva Stadium for sports and games. Medical care centre inside the campus for emergencies.

individual_reviews.title: An institution of dreams with a scope of preparing entrepreneurs and global leaders.

content.Infrastructure: Lush Green Campus at Nitte (An interior place between Karkala and Bangalore). AC equipped auditorium with a capacity of 400 seating. Full-fledged classrooms equipped with projectors. Library with 77000+ books and magazines. Bloomberg Finance Lab for research and analysis.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Operations Management - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Review of Justice K S Hegde Institute of Management.

content.Infrastructure: Our college provides all the best facilities for the students. Our college provides facilities like Wi-Fi, air-conditioned classrooms, a huge library with 2500 books and the best labs. Facilities available are quit improved from the previous year. Sports facilities are perfect. Our college provides ground for any type of sport. There is a free medical kit for students.
content.Faculty: Teachers in our college are highly knowledgeable. They have experience of about 10 years in teaching, and their teaching quality is perfect. They provide projector-based studies. They make students perfectly industry-ready.

individual_reviews.course: MBA in Operations Management - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: The college provides good infrastructure, facilities and faculty members.

content.Placements: The intake of our college is 180, and in the previous year out of 180 students, nearly 120 were placed. Top recruiting companies of our college are Grand Thornton, ICICI Bank, Curltfit, Oracle and KPMG. The salary package offered is around 4 LPA to 6 LPA. Generally, students take an internship after the end of the second semester.

highlights.summary:
Founded in 2006 by an Act of State Legislature of Uttar Pradesh, Mohammad Ali Jauhar University (MAJU) came into being via Section 2(F) of UGC Act, 1956. It is a private university located in Rampur, Uttar Pradesh that offers UG, PG and diploma and PG diploma programmes across multiple streams such as Engineering, Management, Law, Science, Arts, Education, Commerce & Accounting, Pharmacy and Mass Communication, among others. All these courses are offered by the 14 departments (faculties) under this University, which include:

Spread over 250 acre of lush green campus, the University is highly focused on the physical well-being of the students. For this purpose, it has a huge, well-equipped and hi-tech gymnasium with indoor gaming facilities, such as badminton, chess, carom, table tennis and outdoor sports facilities like football, hockey, cricket, lawn tennis, volleyball and horse riding. Other chief USPs of this University are listed below:

MAJU has formed collaborations with several European universities provide its students with the status of being global. They are also are further expanding across several universities of the Middle-East and Africa.

Mohammad Ali Jauhar University admission process takes place in both via online and offline modes. Aspirants can download the application form and prospectus from the official website or buy it offline from the admission cell on payment of the application fee via cash or DD. The University conducts an entrance exam for admission to a few courses and for the remaining courses, admission is subject to merit scores in the last qualifying exam. review_summary.college_name: Mohammad Ali Jauhar University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. In Zoology - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: I am totally satisfied with my university.

content.Placements: Students won't get placed, but in the previous batches, students got placed in some areas. The highest package offered is 1 LPA. The lowest salary offered is Rs. 70,000. Students got internships from our course as medical officers in some areas.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure of the college are up to the mark. The lecture theatres are well built with AC, and hostel facilities are not provided. The quality of the food available in the canteen is okay. Medical facilities are also provided in the university, and sports and games facilities are available as well.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied because the college faculty, infrastructure, and facilities are very good.

content.Placements: 50% to 60% of students got placed. The highest package is 10 lacs per annum. The lowest package is 3.5 lacs per annum. Average package is 5 to 6 lacs per annum. The courses offered are Bachelor of technology in electrical and electronics engineering, mechanical engineering, civil engineering, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, labs, a good classroom, a very beautiful library, etc. are there. All facilities are good in this college. Mess and canteen food is very hygienic and there is a clean canteen. Medical facilities are average. Sports and games are also running in this university. My university is very beautiful.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: Very poor university for education.

content.Placements: There are no placements in this college. They just made a fool out of all the mechanical students of 2016 batch. This is a nonsense university, and the placement facilities are very poor. They just complete the students' course like BA and B.Sc students. I will never advise my friends to take admission.
content.Infrastructure: It's not a university; it is a primary school in which they treat students as KG school students. We don't know how the college library and labs look because we never used them before. There are no facilities like Wi-Fi, library, medical facility or games. It is all only for the prospectus, not in reality.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: Huge Need Of Placement to our college.

content.Placements: There are no placements in our college because it is a new university. And another reason for it is that the college management does not want to place students in any company that can terminate their students within some months. I think this thinking of management is bad. The placement is necessary for the college's Improvement.
content.Infrastructure: Everything is okay! Like classrooms, faculty, labs etc. As we know in the colleges, a library plays a vital role. So, in our college, a helpful library is available which named as Central Mumtaz Library in a wide space and having a good design. The faculty and management are okay. In short, the college is good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: One of the wrost college in India.

content.Placements: Poor placement facilities. Nobody was placed from our batch. They just called a consultancy for the sake of advertisement and news. The HR management asks some stupid and non-technical questions. After a few times, they would say that you are selected but in reality, they just fool you. Thus, the placement facilities are very, very poor in this college.
content.Infrastructure: The college has a good Wi-Fi strength but it is only for official use. No student can use the Wi-Fi due to college rule. The labs are good and the instrument and machine are only for show, not for use. There are no proficient lab assistants in the college. The college has various playgrounds but one cannot play without permission.

faqs.answer: Yes, Mohammad Ali Jauhar University conduct an entrance test to shortlist candidates for admission. However, entrance test is not mandatory for all the courses. Aspirants applying for MBA, BTech, B.Ed, BPharm, MPharm, MCA or DPharm have to appear for the admission test conducted by the university. Aspirants appearing for the test can check the entrance exam result on the official website of the university. Selected candidates need to pay some part of the course fee at the time or admission to confirm their seat.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to Mohammad Ali Jauhar University?
faqs.answer: Mohammad Ali Jauhar University admissions are both merit and entrance-based. The university conducts an admission test to shortlist candidates for admission to BTech, BPharm, MBA, MPharm, etc. Admission to most of the UG and PG courses is based on merit of the aspirants in the last qualifying exam. Selected candidates need to report at the campus for document verification and fee payment to confirm their seat.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at Mohammad Ali Jauhar University?
faqs.answer: Mohammad Ali Jauhar University offers admission to courses based on the score of the candidates in the admission test conducted by the university or qualifying exam. Aspirants must check the requirement for their course to get admission in the university. MAJU begins admission cycle in February with the application process. Selected candidates need to confirm their seat by paying the course fee at Mohammad Ali Jauhar University.

faqs.question: Can humanities students get admission to Mohammad Ali Jauhar University BCom?
faqs.answer: BCom admission criteria at Mohammad Ali Jauhar University require students to have studied commerce or Science at the Class 12 level. Humanities students may not be eligible unless the university updates its criteria. It's recommended to check with the admissions office for the most recent eligibility guidelines.

reviews.review_heading: I am totally satisfied with my university.

Wi-Fi, labs, a good classroom, a very beautiful library, etc. are there.

Sports and games are also running in this university. 
My university is very beautiful.

reviews.review_heading: Huge Need Of Placement to our college.

So, in our college, a helpful library is available which named as Central Mumtaz Library in a wide space and having a good design. The faculty and management are okay. In short, the college is good.

reviews.review_heading: One of the wrost college in India.
reviews.review_text:
The college has a good Wi-Fi strength but it is only for official use. No student can use the Wi-Fi due to college rule.
The labs are good and the instrument and machine are only for show, not for use. There are no proficient lab assistants in the college.
The college has various playgrounds but one cannot play without permission.

reviews.review_heading: I will not recommend taking admission.
reviews.review_text:
There is no proper Infrastructure. The labs for ME and CE do not have any equipment and Machines except the hall.
There is no Wi-Fi for the students, and you are not allowed to pick and select the book of your desire as you will have to request from the librarian. Books are allowed for one week only, and for others, you will be charged per day.
There is no arrangement for quality food and meals, but the classrooms and the hostel are good.

reviews.review_heading: Our college provides good facilities and placements.
reviews.review_text: Facilities provided on campus are very good. There are good quality roads and transport facilities. Free Wi-Fi is provided for students. Library is available with books to study. Hostel is good and clean. It serves tasty food. Sports facilities are available.

review_summary.college_name: Sir Chotu Ram Institute of Engineering and Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is the worst college, but one thing is good, that there is no pressure for attendance.

content.Placements: There are no placements. Even small companies do not come. Even TCS company does not visit here. There is no competition in the tech-related field. Even the hackathon team is not selected from my college, besides students participating. It does not conduct any tour, and we will not get the college life that we hope for.
content.Infrastructure: There is a small room and three people have to live there. The mess food is worse than stall food. There is no canteen. Hostel timing for girls in the evening is only 6:00 PM. Staff and matrons are very rude and go against our character. Bathrooms are also very dirty.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Decent placements and supportive faculty members with good campus life.

content.Placements: Placements in the computer science branch are decent but can vary from batch to batch. Around 40–50 percent of students in my batch got placed through campus drives, while others secured opportunities off-campus. The highest package offered is about 6 LPA. The lowest is around 2 LPA, and the average is near 3 LPA – 3.5 LPA. Companies like TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Tech Mahindra, and some startups visited the campus. Around 20–25 percent of students also received internships in roles like software development, testing, and support. Placements are satisfactory, but consistent preparation beyond campus drives improves the chances.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Lateral Entry) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Department of technology, CCSU.

content.Placements: There is a great active placement cell in my college which helps many students to get their dream job and to be successful in life. Approximately 90% of students got their placement in the placement cell and top companies comes to our college. Various types of job opportunities are there.
content.Infrastructure: College infrastructure is very good and attractive, all the buildings are well-maintained and very attractive. There is Wi-Fi available on the overall campus, and there is a very vast playground. There are various canteens in which food quality is very good and satisfactory.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: The college has good infrastructure.

content.Placements: 90% of students got placed in our college. The college provides complete guidance and assistance to the students. The lowest package is 1.5 LPA, maximum is 5 LPA. Top companies like Wipro and Google approached the employee as an intern. Top recruiters are Wipro, Google, and Adobe. Around 50% of students got internships. Top roles offered are accounting, sales, finance, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The college has good furniture and clean classrooms. We have helpful staff with AV rooms where they can visually explain the subjects and chapters which makes it easy to understand. They provide the projectors in each class. Proper facilities for sports like badminton, cricket and so on.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc (Honours) in Computer Science - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Both infrastructure and faculty members are very good. Placements are available here.

content.Placements: In my college, some companies like Unacademy and Infosys visit the college for placements. Some students in my course also do internships. In my college, the highest package is 6 LPA and the minimum package is 3 LPA. Students passing from my university are also working in some big companies and some students are working in Microsoft and some in Google.
content.Infrastructure: If I talk about facilities, then the facility of Wi-Fi in my department is very good. The computer lab is available. Classrooms are also very good. The hostel food is not a little better to eat.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: My honest review about my college.

content.Placements: Speaking about placements, since this is a medical college, there are no placement opportunities like those in engineering colleges. Students can join other hospitals, start their own clinic, or pursue higher studies. There is a 1-year internship.
content.Infrastructure: I am from another state, so I opted for a hostel. The hostel is really good. They have separate hostels for girls and boys, separate junior and senior hostels, and even NRI hostels with more luxuries. They also have many workers who clean the rooms daily

individual_reviews.course: Discontinued(Nov 2025)- Bachelor of Business Management - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with our college because they offer many placements.

content.Placements: Around 300 students, only 150 students are selected. They offer a job package of 1.5 LPA. They mainly offer jobs in IT companies like Accenture, etc. They recruit to IT companies like Accenture, Wipro, Infosys, IBM, and have a very different range of jobs provided to the students.
content.Infrastructure: A very good infrastructure and very beautiful classrooms surrounded by trees and fresh air. We had very interesting classes projected on the whiteboards. They have very good computer labs that offer a fabulous and more interesting studying experience.

individual_reviews.course: Discontinued(Nov 2025)- Bachelor of Business Management - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: Well planned and trained professionals. The faculty also improves the placements in 2017.

content.Placements: The placement process is quite well, and it is totally dependent upon the student's performance and their talents. In order to have the future of excellence and experience, the steps taken should be aqueous to learn and be polite to handle the project. The faculty will be solving problems which you got.
content.Infrastructure: The college has an optimist structure and well-implemented library and classroom, Make your passion in reality in nature. The infrastructure is also based on the go-green concept, hence lots of green is nearby and will maintain the college with all the amenities and a good quality of happiness.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Averagely satisfied with my college.

content.Placements: Senior batches didn't get good placements from the college. Here, 10% of the students got placed. The highest salary is Rs. 25,000 per month and the lowest is Rs. 13,000. The companies that visit the campus are the Vivo offering the support roles but no internships from the college which will be 2 months minimum and 3 months being the highest. Our college is an average type of college, but it is sufficient for the poor people who can not afford much fees.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available in some departments. Here, classrooms are good, the library is good, not very well medical facilities, not good sports and games exposure. The quality of the labs and classrooms is also average, and the quality of the food in the canteen is also average. Hostel rooms are good. But the Issue is with its space which is very less.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2014
individual_reviews.title: Paradise of knowledge- education with extra curricular activities makes the students extrovert.

content.Placements: The placements were good with companies like Axis Bank, IndusInd Bank, etc. hiring the students. We also had internships offered by companies like State Street Global Advisors, Exide Company, Bosch, Accupac, Rail and Wheel Company. 80% of students got internships in our batch. The highest stipend was 15,000 INR and the lowest would be 8,000 INR. Campus recruitment was held by TCS.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities offered on the campus is excellent with a computer lab and Wi-Fi provided to the students for gaining knowledge through internet. Cricket and athletics are given more focus and we have been champions and have achieved name and fame and trophies in the true spirit of championship. The quality of the classrooms is good with fans, proper light, and fresh air available from the garden on the campus. Projectors and screens are available for the students to understand better through audio and visual media. The quality of food is good. Al Ameen College is renowned and students from different countries come here to study pharmacy. The hostel facilities are good, which is provided along with bus service. The infrastructure is too good and they have recently built another block for the BBA department.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2016
individual_reviews.title: Our college is the best all over India.

content.Placements: The placements in our college are good for all batches. Approximately 85 % of students were placed. The highest salary expected is Rs. 45,000 per month and the lowest salary is Rs. 20,000 per month. They offered good roles to all the students. Approximately, 75% of the students got the internships. I'm one among them. Overall, it is the best college I have ever studied.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has good infrastructure. The labs are good. Hostels rooms are also very neat and clean. We have a Wi-Fi facility in the college. The food in the canteen is very delicious. We didn't face any problem regarding the infrastructure during my tenure. The classrooms are very good. There is a special interest in sports and games also.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2014

content.Other: This college consists of good and experienced faculty members, It possesses a good library with good collection of books, canteen and lab facility. The college has very good infrastructure. It also has several programs to develop the student skills such as "ISTL, CSR-Uttaran, Intercollegiate activities. College is providing very good campus placement and internship both within India and outside every year. Overall, the college possesses a good brand image by its campus facilities, and placements to students.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Good college Rule and regulation are too hard but is for your betterment.

content.Placements: Placement is 100% and the batch size of college is too small because of rule and regulation they provide industrial visit in winter and summer internship in good companies like Autofit, Sunbeam etc., and they also provide international internship in DOHA Bank Qatar 2 of my senior are complete their internship in August and like I said placement is 100% the avg package is 4 Lacs.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is really good a garden in mid of college. Campus beauty is here a temple inside the campus where we start our morning with sadhna, and read daily news headlines. Here 150 desktop in lab and fully Wi-Fi campus but you can't use mobile phone inside the campus and classes infra really good and canteen food is good afternoon food is free for all who live in hostel and who is not.

individual_reviews.course: Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) - Batch of 2017
individual_reviews.title: The college is very good for studies.

content.Placements: In this college, the teaching quality is good. All the students can score above 65%. The internship rate of our batch is 98%. The college is in a very peaceful place, and the staff of the college are superb.
content.Infrastructure: There are 2 Wi-Fi zones in the college. Almost all students are utilizing this. There are separate labs for different branches. All the instruments are present in the labs, and maintenance is also good. The classrooms are clean and good. There are no medical facilities.
content.Faculty: The teaching quality is very good in my point of view. The teachers are very friendly with students. We can go staff room at any time with our doubts, and they never regret it. They all are very humble and nice to students. The principal of our college is very good to students.

individual_reviews.title: Good placements and faculty.

content.Placements: Wipro company offering 4.5 LPA for Computer Science Engineering students.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is good. Classroom maintenance is good. Library is also very decent
content.Faculty: Teaching is good, but some are helpful. Faculty are friendly and clear doubts about class. Teaching very well. Semester exams are very difficult to write, and another task is to write supplementary exams. Very strict about exams and faculty also.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: My college is good for all.

content.Placements: A minimum of 80 percent of students got placed at the end of the course. The highest package is 24 LPA and the lowest is 3.5 LPA offered by my college. There are so many top recruiting companies for my college. Top recruiting companies are HCL, TCS, Cognizant, Capgemini, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Very good facilities are available for college, including a good lab facility with good teachers. Lab equipment and good lab instruments are available. Good Wi-Fi facility for systems. Classrooms are neat, I don't know about hostels. Sports also happen in my college, etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Join this college. Placements are average, and faculty can be considered moderate.

content.Placements: In our college, placements are available, but we should not over-expect, as they claim 100 percent placement. Many people know it is not possible to provide a job for every student. We do have some average placements. The highest placement is 24 LPA, which is only for one person. Others get general average packages. We need to consider the reality of software companies, as hiring is a bit low right now.

hostel.description:
Students come to the institute from every corner of the country. The Hostel is surrounded by beautiful lawns and plantation which gives the feeling of a home away from home.

Single room accommodations are well furnished, airy, with proper house keeping facilities, telephone facilities and other amenities as well.
A mess with neat and clean kitchen is attached with a dinning hall
Common room has TV with cable connection
Accommodations are separate for boys & girls.
Hostel is allotted on first come first served basis.

library.description:
The Library has some 6367 books (of 2026 titles), 20 national and international journals and latest magazines covering all aspects of management studies and computers.
The Digital Library is implemented through 4 Multimedia PCs connected to high speed internet. There is a separate section for audio & video CDs.
The Library also has an institutional membership of British Council Library and their online data through British council online which provides access to world-class journals in the field of management.
The UGC-Infonet Digital Library Consortium provides current as well as archival access to more than 1500 core and peer-reviewed journals and nine bibliographic databases from 23 publishers and aggregators in different disciplines.
The programme is wholly funded by the UGC and executed by the INFLIBNET (Information and Library Network) Centre, Ahmedabad.

review_summary.college_name: Birla Institute of Technology, Mesra - Lalpur Extension Center Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with the college and its faculty members. It has good infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: Almost 80% of students get placed. Each year, new companies arrive for placements of students. Students are being offered a minimum package that ranges from 4-20 LPA. Companies like Tata Consultancy Services, Cognizant, Wipro, Infosys, Deloitte, etc., hire students.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are available with projectors. A lift is available for both students and faculty members. The college focuses on sports and events too. Medical facilities and labs are also available. A big parking facility is available with several guards in the college for security. There is a big area behind the college for conducting events and programs.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: BCA that builds your future.

content.Placements: Birla Institute of Technology, Lalpur, offers a decent course. The highest placement package is 10 LPA, and the lowest is 3 LPA. Around 65% of students got internships. Top recruiters include TCS, Wipro, and Infosys. TCS offered top roles like software developer.
content.Infrastructure: The BCA department has good infrastructure with smart classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, computer labs, and a digital library. Facilities are provided on a first-come, first-serve basis for new admissions. Hostels are decent, with clean rooms, mess, and 24/7 security.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The worst college, no value for money, no ROI.

content.Placements: Only 2-3 students are placed out of 250. No known companies come for internships provided by the college. Not all students are allowed to sit for campus placements; only a few get the chance to sit for campus placements. The average is 3.26 LPA, which is low.
content.Infrastructure: There is no infrastructure, no hostel, and no structural development. The college looks like a coaching center. There is no food court, no auditorium, and nothing is there on the college campus. The medical room also does not have proper things. There is no ground to play sports.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Some faculty members are good. Their way of teaching is absolutely amazing.

content.Placements: Placement opportunities are quite limited after completing a BBA from BIT Mesra Lalpur. Students are generally required to find summer internships on their own, as we are not permitted to pursue internships at other times. While some placements do occur, only a few companies visit our college.
content.Infrastructure: BIT Lalpur does not have its hostel, so you will need to find accommodation on your own. There is no canteen on campus, and sports activities are only conducted during specific events like Aurora. The medical facilities available are limited. There is a library on site, although Wi-Fi is not provided.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: College is not best, but not worst either.

content.Placements: I am in my 5th semester, and so far, only 2 students out of 150 from my batch have received placements. By the end of the 6th semester, I hope more students will be placed. The salary packages offered are 3 LPA to 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies included Accenture India, Infosys, Zen Trade, QuickShell, and Tata Consultancy Services Ltd.
content.Infrastructure: At Birla Institute of Technology, Lalpur Campus, infrastructure is very limited, with only 15 classrooms available for BCA and BBA students, excluding the computer lab. Campus is very small, consisting of just two buildings, which gives it the feel of private coaching. This impression is accurate because there is no uniform for current students. But, new batch of 2024-2025 BCA students will have a black-and-white uniform. There is no canteen on the campus either.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: The worst college you'll ever join.

content.Placements: There are absolutely no placements related to the course, just a few startups have shown up, and they are offering less than what a domestic house help would receive on a monthly basis. There are no IT jobs, and all placements that are shown outside on billboards are fake.
content.Infrastructure: It’s fine, buildings are huge, but there is no maintenance. The infrastructure is good, but again, don’t judge a book by its cover. Hence, don’t join this college just because it has nice infrastructure, because it is a waste of time and money to join. I made the same mistake by joining it only because of the infrastructure.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Information Technology - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: I'm not satisfied with the college and course because of no placements and poor teaching quality.

content.Placements: Around 20% of students got placed from our course. The regular salary package offered in our course is 3 LPA. Accenture and Test Yantra are the regular recruiting companies in our batch. Main roles offered are application developer and software engineer. Overall placements are bad.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms are available with projectors. Labs are nice with good computer systems and air-conditioners. Libraries are equipped with all course books, newspapers, and research. Hostels provide quality food and facilities but are quite expensive for both boys and girls and they are near to the college too.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: A good college with average infrastructure facilities.

content.Placements: I am a student of Computer Science and Engineering from 2026 passing out batch. Our college is average in terms of placement provision. In our college, around 50% of students get placements. The highest salary package offered in our college is 10 LPA and the lowest salary package offered is 2 LPA. Top recruiting companies in our college are Wipro, Accenture, Tech Mahindra, TCS, and Global Logic. Roles offered in our college are Analyst and Developer.
content.Infrastructure: Our college is best in terms of infrastructure, with good classrooms, labs for every department, a big library, and free Wi-Fi facility. Quality of facilities in our college and hostel is good. College has all types of transport facilities. Food available in mess and canteen is excellent. College provides free medical facilities and many sports grounds for every sport in our college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The sad reality of private colleges.

content.Placements: Nearly 80% of students got placed in our college. The highest package offered in our college was nearly 12 LPA, and the average package offered in our college was around 4-4.5 LPA. The percentage of students who got internships was very low; most of us got internships from LinkedIn.
content.Infrastructure: Some faculty members are not sufficiently qualified according to teaching standards, and labs are in okay condition and not fully enough to meet students' needs. The food we have to buy from the canteen, and the games are good at the beginning and gradually decrease to none.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Expectations vs. Reality of the College.

content.Placements: I am pursuing CSE in Data Science. There's no specific highest or lowest package for our college since we only get one company, and that is Accenture. The percentage of internships offered in our college is 5%. My course offers me a job as a data analyst, which is more advanced and useful for companies.
content.Infrastructure: We have Wi-Fi, programming labs, and a library in our college. However, the canteen serves worse food than we expected, and the prices are very high. The games we can play in our college include basketball and cricket, but those who like soccer won’t have the opportunity to play.

individual_reviews.course: B.A(Hons.). in Psychology - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and facilities with an advanced teaching style.

content.Placements: About 70% of students are placed in the course. Top recruiting companies from overseas and India. More than 50% of students got internships. Top roles are leadership roles, research, presentations, etc. Banking Sectors during job fair come for interns like Canara.
content.Infrastructure: There is a classroom, two labs, and an advanced library with top-notch maintenance. Hostel is next to the college, and the quality of facilities provided is top-notch, food is really good and nutritious. A mess and canteen are available, and a playground.

individual_reviews.course: B.Com. in Professional - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Things to Know Before You Join.

content.Placements: Agnes provides the students with greater job opportunities from well-developed companies such as Wipro, Infosys, Tata Consultancy, and many others. Students who are interested in getting into the IT field opt for this and grab the best opportunity to fulfill their dreams.
content.Infrastructure: The college provides us with a well-structured library, which makes it easier for students to study and do their work in a peaceful environment. Along with that, the well-equipped computer labs and science labs help students a lot in learning and understanding the process of the work.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Value based education and eco friendly campus.

content.Placements: 80 percent of students were placed in my course. 9 LPA was the highest package offered in my course, 5 LPA was the average package offered in my course and 3 LPA was the lowest package offered in my course. NASA, IISC, RESEARCH INSTITUTE, etc., are the top recruiting companies for my course. About 55 percent of students got internships from my course in India's topmost companies. Food check officer, researchers, chemists, and lecturers were the top roles offered in my course.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi network, well-equipped laboratory, auditorium, classroom, well-developed and furnished modest library, good counseling center, gym for the physical fitness of students, grievance redressal cell, internet laboratory, studio for students, equal opportunity for students, instrumental laboratory, anti-sexual harassment cell, career guidance counselor and programs, placement cell, SC / ST cell, women's centre, helpline centre, museum, anti-ragging cell, canteen, hostel, indoor and outdoor games, etc. Are the facilities and infrastructure available for my course and department. Very good quality of the facilities in the hostel and the food available in mess and change are very good.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: One of the best colleges in Mangalore .

content.Placements: The students with higher marks are getting very quick admission. The course I chose is B.A. in psychology. You can do clinical psychology later on. Students here have to choose hospitals or industries to do internships. The highest mark is 90% above.
content.Infrastructure: They've got labs for biology, microbiology, psychology, nutrition, computers, journalism, secretary practice, and the chemistry and physics lab. They have very good quality facilities in the hostel. They have a very good sports room with many indoor and outdoor games .

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: My proud college in Bangalore.

content.Placements: There are a number of students studying in our college. A good number of students got internships and were selected for different job offers in high-profile companies. The college offers various roles such as president, vice president, and secretary, among others. The students are offered some of the leadership roles.
content.Infrastructure: They offer us computers in the labs and a variety of equipment to operate. There is plenty of food, both veg and non-veg. The facilities of the college are very good and of high quality. They offer many menus according to our choice. Sports facilities and restrooms are available in the college.

Along with that, the well-equipped computer labs and science labs help students a lot in learning and understanding the process of the work.

reviews.review_heading: Value based education and eco friendly campus.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi network, well-equipped laboratory, auditorium, classroom, well-developed and furnished modest library, good counseling center, gym for the physical fitness of students, grievance redressal cell, internet laboratory, studio for students, equal opportunity for students, instrumental laboratory, anti-sexual harassment cell, career guidance counselor and programs, placement cell, SC / ST cell, women's centre, helpline centre, museum, anti-ragging cell, canteen, hostel, indoor and outdoor games...

reviews.review_heading: One of the best colleges in Mangalore .
reviews.review_text: They've got labs for biology, microbiology, psychology, nutrition, computers, journalism, secretary practice, and the chemistry and physics lab. They have very good quality facilities in the hostel. They have a very good sports room with many indoor and outdoor games .

reviews.review_heading: My proud college in Bangalore.
reviews.review_text: They offer us computers in the labs and a variety of equipment to operate. There is plenty of food, both veg and non-veg. The facilities of the college are very good and of high quality. They offer many menus according to our choice. Sports facilities and restrooms are available in the college.

reviews.review_heading: The college has well qualified faculty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure offered at the college was good for the B.Com. course. The facilities were good at this college. Labs, libraries, Wi-Fi, canteens, etc. were available in the college for the students. Hostel facilities were also available at our college. Sports and other necessary facilities were also given to the students.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely worth taking admission here.
reviews.review_text: Our classes were neat and clean. Labs were all in good condition. Every department had its own Wi-Fi facility. Department computers were also there. Each class has its own projector which are very helpful during presentations.

reviews.review_heading: Overall its a great college .
reviews.review_text: As in the lectures are very good and friendly the infrastructure are also good. But lab facilities are not that great they still use old techniques. And even the hostel is good but the food facilities are not that great. They don't have a big play ground facility but yaa it's fine we can manage.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with no proper washroom.
reviews.review_text: Only girls hostel is available for now. Water facilities aren't that great and there are cafe and canteen in the campus. There is 5-6 smart class projectors are available and new building built for centenary has huge library with many computers for students access. Gym and sport room is available and Sick room is very tiny but always kept clean. No Wi-Fi provided from college. B.A. has psychology lab and journalism department owns radio studio which is most of the time locked. Camera for events ...

reviews.review_heading: The college environment is really good. The faculty is also good.
reviews.review_text: The college has hostel facilities in the campus for girls. The hostel is okay. There was no Wi-Fi facility for us. Hygiene is above average. The college campus is good. The campus is really calm, beautiful and peaceful. The college provides a very good study environment.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with a good learning experience.
reviews.review_text: We have a canteen a bit far from our block and a small food stall near our block. The food is good, and you can find common food items here. The labs are well-equipped for our course. Our library is our pride, with a number of books to read. You will never be disappointed, and the ambiance in the library is very good, especially with an individual study cubicle. No Wi-Fi is available here for students. In computer labs, it is provided for computers to operate. Classrooms and infrastructure have ...

reviews.review_heading: It has a good education system and good faculty.
reviews.review_text: It has good infrastructure and good facilities in our college. There are good lab facilities. Hostel facilities are on campus only. There are two canteens where you will get all the food items. The college is supportive of sports and games.  There is a huge and new library that helps the students with their educational purposes as well as knowledge.

reviews.review_heading: College life - could have been better.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure needs to be improved. The library is good with tons of books of different genres. Labs are pretty decent. The hostel facility needs to improve a lot. There have been quite a few complaints from the college hostel. The canteen has good food for cheaper rates but it needs to be more hygienic. The games room has various sports equipments but again they need to be replaced with new ones.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied because of the faculty and everything here.
reviews.review_text:
The college has good labs, classrooms, and library. 
The food quality in our hostel mess and canteen is good. Medical facilities, sports and games are available.

review_summary.college_name: CHMM College of Advanced Studies Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Com. in Computer Application - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Our college is good for studying because they lack a good canteen, campus, and events.

content.Placements: There was only one company that provided placement for the commerce department is an Insurance agency. There are plenty of companies for BCA, MCA, and B.Sc. computer science with salary packages.
content.Infrastructure: There is no Wi-Fi. Labs and classrooms are normal. There is no hostel but there is a canteen with snacks and juices and has no lunch or breakfast. The quality of food in the canteen is worst. College is smaller than a school with 2 buildings.
content.Faculty: Teachers are helpful and knowledgeable. They make students industry-ready. B.Com was simple with a great pass percentage which is above 90%. Students need to wait for 2 to 3 months or even 4 months to know their results.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. in English - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Review of CHMM College of Advanced Studies.

content.Placements: In our college, a few students were placed.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provided average facilities and infrastructure. The canteen facilities were not good. Sports and games were not conducted. Medical facilities were not available. Washrooms were not good. The atmosphere of the college was not good.
content.Faculty: Our faculty members were average. They were helpful. Semester exams were difficult. The pass percentage was 50%. Many students failed exams. Our teachers did not give us proper attention.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: This college is good with good facilities, and you will love this college.

content.Placements: About 75% of students got placed in high-end companies. The highest package offered is 12 LPA, and the average package is 5 LPA. Companies that hire students are Infosys, Wipro, Ecocity, etc. 100% of students got placed as interns in public companies. Roles offered include business analyst, financial analyst, business executive, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The classrooms have modern technology and Wi-Fi. The library has a huge collection of books. The quality of facilities in the hostel is good, and the food quality in the canteen is the best. There are medical facilities in our college, along with a doctor and a nurse. Sports and games activities are conducted every year.

individual_reviews.course: B.Com. in Travel and Tourism Management - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Chmm college chavarcode trivandrum review.

content.Placements: Placements and industry exposure of this college is very low. They provide 1 monthly internship to all students of B.Com tourism and travel management. Students can select their internship areas according to their interests. There are 60 seats in B.Com travel and tourism course. Students can look for jobs in various tourism and hospitality sectors after this course. Apart from the lack of placement, the course is superb and useful. 90 per cent of students in my class doing jobs now in various sectors with this degree.
content.Infrastructure: This college is situated near chavarcode which is 2 km from paripally. The atmosphere and infrastructure of this college are superb. The college has a library that has all kinds of text and reference books for the students and is a perfect place for book lovers. College provides a canteen where students get good meals and snacks. Classrooms have enough space and Transport facilities available to cater to the needs of students and staff. There is a computer lab which satisfies all technological requirements of students. This college has sports facilities for all students like football ground, volleyball court kabaddi etc. Medical first aid facilities are also provided. The college has no hostel facilities because students are from 30 km radius only.

individual_reviews.course: Intergrated Master of Business Administration (IMBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Our college provides really best facilities.

content.Placements: From our college, students were placed from our course with a salary package of 10 LPA. Top companies which visit here for placements are Reliance Jio, ICICI Bank, HDFC Bank, Tata group of companies, Birla Housing Finance company, etc. Top courses offered on our campus are MBA and MCA.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides the best and very good facilities. In our course, the infrastructure available includes Wi-Fi service, labs, many computer labs and huge and clean classrooms. The library is the best peaceful area on our campus.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Overall, it is a very good college.

content.Placements: It is a good college for MCA. Our college also focuses on placements and asks how was the placement interview, and they also guide where we are wrong. Everyone who is looking for a college should opt for this college.
content.Infrastructure: The campus has many facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, libraries, a garden and a canteen for all students. There are hostels, and I think they would be good. There is a library facility, and they also encourage students for extra activities.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: BIMS is one of the best colleges in Ahmedabad for pursuing MBA and MCA course.

content.Placements: Our institute provides 100% placements. The highest salary package offered is 5.00 LPA and the minimum salary package offered is 2.00 LPA. Companies like TCS, Axis Bank, Janalakshmi Finance Ltd, Abhinav Polymers, Divya Bhaskar, HDFC Bank, Justdial, ICICI Bank and Gujarat Samachar are the top recruiters of our college. Almost 100% of the students are getting an internship in different companies like Uttam Dairy, Madhur Dairy, banks, industries, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The library is good and equipped with all subject books, and a digital library is also available. National journal and a foreign journal are also available here. Computer labs are equipped with all the latest software and technology. There are smart classrooms, Wi-Fi facility and air-conditioning classrooms in our college.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: It was good to study at RBIMS.

content.Placements: The placement was average. Only a few of us were selected for the placements. We had placements from 3 to 4 companies. Technologies preferred are ruby on rails, Java and .NET. Interviews are not conducted much. Still, we had few companies that conducted interviews for us.
content.Infrastructure: We had Wi-Fi facility but not for students. Classrooms were good. Tech lab was good. There was a little garden in the college. There was a library too, but they need to increase the number of books in the library. The college was converted from the school, and the premises was a school in the past, because of which the classrooms are quite small.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: It is not worthy. It is waste of money and time.

content.Placements: Our college is not good for placement. You can find better than this college in Ahmedabad. There is no big scope for placement. You will not get a job in the college placement. No big company come for placement. Please don't join this college.
content.Infrastructure: Regarding infrastructure, it is an average college in Ahmedabad. You can find better one in Ahmedabad. The labs and the library are not up to mark than other colleges in Ahmedabad. There are no playing teams, and indoor games are not encouraged. You will not get any luxurious life in this college.

review_summary.college_name: VLB College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Management - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Overall, I am satisfied with it.

content.Placements: A majority of students get placed in my department. Accenture recruited students from the college. Many students get offer letters in my batch. Many companies recruit students from our batch. High-level companies provide internships in the college.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is available. Lab facilities are provided. It has a nice library, and it has many books. The quality of food is available in the mess. Medical facilities are provided by the college. Facilities in our hostel are very good. I am very satisfied with the college infrastructure. It provides many facilities.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Their consultancy is an absolute waste of money. College management is good.

content.Placements: Our college has top placement cell and pushes the students to attend the placement drives. Companies like Accenture, KGIS, Apexon, etc., come for hiring. If the students are willing to attend the interview you can gain a lot of interview experience. But the consultancy there doesn't provide any interviews. I consider joining planet courses rather than add-on courses through their consultancy.
content.Infrastructure: Food is not up to mark as the fee is so high (70,000 per year). Warden is strict and ensures the safety of the students to an extent. Talking about the infrastructure of the college is strictly average. There are 3 blocks compared to A block. B block doesn't have proper facilities although they are trying to make it better. Better late than never. Wi-Fi is available only in A block. Library doesn't have updated books and most books are old interpretations.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Science - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely good college, and the students can easily go for it.

content.Placements: I was pursuing a B.Sc. Computer Science in this college. So, college placements are more important to me. They offered from the lowest-paid company to the highest-paid. For my course, IT companies are the most important, so they also provide me with those opportunities. Overall, everything is good.
content.Infrastructure: The college has a wide range of Wi-Fi facilities, and the college environment is very peaceful. Labs are also well organized. Classrooms and libraries are well-cleaned, and there are many clubs in this college. There are many sports equipment and game tools.

individual_reviews.course: BBA in Computer Application - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Our college campus and faculty members are very good.

content.Placements: More than 50% of students got placed in our college. The salary offered ranges between Rs. 15,000-40,000 per month. TCS and Wipro are top recruiting MNCs. Top roles offered are managing director, assistant manager, frontend developer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: All facilities are good. Wi-Fi is available in our college. Our college provides facilities like a security service, water, food, clean classrooms, a library, etc. A playground is outside of our college.
content.Faculty: All teachers are the best. All subjects are very relevant to all courses. It is not difficult to clear exams. They provide training before exams. It is easy to clear exams. All courses are related to the industry.

individual_reviews.course: B.Com. in Computer Applications - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Average infrastructure, good teachers, good semester results.

content.Placements: About 50-70% is placed every year, but it various with the student percentage and their talents infosys is the company. I heard of it in my college advertisement in the banners and most jobs offered are computer-related and bank and account related.
content.Infrastructure: My college infrastructure features, no Wi-Fi, and labs are available 2, per block total of 5 or 6 I think there is no unavailability of classrooms on campus, but there is one problem not currently organizing the classes in exam times.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, I am satisfied with it.

reviews.review_heading: Our college campus and faculty members are very good.

reviews.review_heading: Average infrastructure, good teachers, good semester results.

reviews.review_heading: Review of V.L.B. Janakiammal College of Arts and Science.

reviews.review_heading: Do check before you get in. Definitely an average college with average placements.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied because our department staffs are very friendly and caring.
reviews.review_text: There are 3 classrooms in our department for a total of 160 students. College infrastructure is very well maintained and always clean. reviews.review_heading: I was dissatisfied with this college because of infrastructure.

reviews.review_heading: VLB Janakiammal College of Arts and Science is the best college.
reviews.review_text: All the facilities are covered here, like the library facilities and more importantly sports facilities. You can also find greenery in the campus surroundings.

reviews.review_heading: Our teachers change students' behavior.
reviews.review_text: Our campus provided good facilities. The infrastructure of our college was very good. Labs, classrooms, and the hostels were air-conditioned. The hostel provided good food. The library had many books.

reviews.review_heading: Review of V.L.B. Janakiammal College of Arts and Science.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is not good. Some washrooms are not good. The hostel is not good. The principal is not good. The food served in the hostel is not good.

reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and smart classrooms were not available in our college. The infrastructure of our college was old. There was no proper ground for students. The computer lab was good. Our college had a good library where all course-related books were available.

reviews.review_heading: The college is really good for all students.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is excellent. The classroom, labs and library are good. Many facilities are available. A good canteen is available. Discipline is maintained in the college.

This college gives importance to outdoor and indoor games as well. It gives the students a good thought about the college as it don't stress out students just in studies.

The mode of application at MCKVIE is online. Candidates need to register and fill out the application form along with an application fee to apply for a course.

hostel_campus.college_name: MCKV Institute of Engineering Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty and library, average placements, but below average canteen.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available on the campus but works well mainly in labs and the library. Classrooms are average, but the library is very good for studying in a quiet environment. Canteen food is below average, and only pure veg meals are available, the campus area is not so big, so the sports facilities are limited.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good and helpful faculty, average placements, a good library, and a poor canteen.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available across the campus, but it does not work. Wi-Fi in the lab and library is good to some extent. The classrooms are average, but the library is really good, and you can study here without any disturbance. The canteen food is below average.

reviews.review_heading: Not satisfied but fine.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are kind of okay and the same goes for the lab. Sometimes all the computers work perfectly fine and sometimes half of them are not working. The library is good enough. No Wi-Fi facilities are provided. I'm not aware of the hostel facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is not at all a good college for any degree in 2025.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms have school benches and they are very hot in the summers. The infrastructure is not at all comparable to any college nearby. The library is available. Wi-Fi in labs does not work very great. The whole campus is a veg campus which is a downgrade for me with respect to any other colleges.

reviews.review_heading: Detailed Review of MCKV INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERING.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are totally fine. Projectors or smart boards are available for better understanding. Video lectures are good. Wi-Fi facility available for students in the cafeteria and library. All kinds of books and a digital library are also available. In the canteen, foods are good, and the hostel is average. Medical facilities and first aid are also available. The campus is totally veg. You can't find any non-veg items in the whole campus and canteen, but still, the foods are tasty and hygienic....

reviews.review_heading: My college is absolutely good and so much fun.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is good. Classrooms are good, but no air conditioners are provided in the classrooms. However, air conditioners are provided in all labs which is good. Our college also provides Wi-Fi and library is good. The hostel is not so good due to some issues and canteen is bad.

reviews.review_heading: Review of MCKV Institute of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Our college we had Wi-Fi available with a 5G network. Labs were well-maintained, but they were less spacious. Classrooms were a bit smaller compared to the number of students admitted every year. Library was good enough and a peaceful place, every student's favorite place. Quality of food in hostel was not good, nor was it in the canteen. Sports and games amenities were available.

reviews.review_heading: Review of MCKV Institute of Engineering
reviews.review_text: The campus is too small. There was one library and a computer lab. Library was very good and there were many books on different fields.

reviews.review_heading: I will say it's decent as such the campus is not that big but the life here is friendly
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure for the Department of Computer Science and Engineering are average in my opinion Let's start with the classrooms, which are well-ventilated and equipped with the latest teaching aids, including LCD projectors and Wi-Fi connectivity but there is a limit in wifi of only 35 mb. The department also has ten laboratories with updated hardware and software, including over about 50 computers with dedicated standby UPS and internet facility with about 30 Mbps.

reviews.review_heading: Best college providing the best future .
reviews.review_text: In this college, the library is so good, but the lab is not that good. Wi-Fi is good, and the classroom is also very good. The quality of our faculty is excellent, and their teaching techniques are very good. They're well experienced and also helpful. I'm not living in a hostel, so I'm not able to say anything about the hostel, but I heard from my friend that it's not good.

reviews.review_heading: College is good and eco-friendly .
reviews.review_text: In our hostel the Wi-Fi is installed by our seniors and we have to have pay for using the Wi-Fi, those students have to pay 50 to 55 rupees each month. Hostel canteen is good for West Bengal student. If you are coming from different states you may find some difficulty in eating but you can manage. Hostel facility is good but not excellent.

reviews.review_heading: I am absolutely satisfied by MCKV Institute of Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is on the average side. The classroom sizes are decent, and Wi-Fi connections are available in the library and labs only, not in the classrooms. The hostel facility is good; the girls' hostel is inside the college, and the boys' hostel is at a walking distance.

reviews.review_heading: Emotions of college life in words.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi connection is so poor on the college campus, but in the library there is a high-speed unlimited Wi-Fi connection. IT at MCKVIE College is a very good course, and no doubt the lab in every subject is outstanding. But as far as I know, the condition of the hostel is so poor, according to some friends.

reviews.review_heading: Decent College Where Besides Completing Your Course, You Can Focus on Other Activities
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is pretty decent. We have Wi-Fi, a library with high capacity, and clean classrooms. The quality of hostel food and canteen options is also good. If any issues arise, they are taken care of. The hostel is located near the college, so timing is not an issue.

reviews.review_heading: My Dream College and Dream Campus Life.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is the best in our college. There are ACs available in hostel rooms for both boys and girls. All types of food, including veg and non-veg, are available here. This hostel is newly built, so it's very clean and fresh. In the boys' hostel, there are no restrictions, but in the girls' hostel, there are some restrictions for the safety of the girls.

reviews.review_heading: About challenging college and best placements.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure was good, and facilities were good. Classrooms were neat and big. Labs were well-equipped. There was high-speed internet connectivity. reviews.review_heading: The best college for M.E. in Structural Engineering.
reviews.review_text: The campus amenities were excellent, laboratories were fully operational, and Wi-Fi facility and security systems were well-equipped. We had a canteen at our college, and the food was of very high quality. There were many opportunities for games and sports.

reviews.review_heading: Wonderful college experience in 2024.

reviews.review_heading: M.E in Structural Engineering.
reviews.review_text: Books were maintained properly and were used by the readers often. To improve our communication skills and keep us updated with everyday news, English newspapers were distributed to each and every student daily. Zonal-level tournaments were conducted in our college.

reviews.review_heading: The best college of my life .
