reviews.review_heading: On summarising, all things are good. It is an average college for fun and placements.
reviews.review_text: It has a very nice and beautiful campus. The infrastructure is not very good, as it provides AC in classrooms or digital boards. It has a decent infrastructure. The hostel facility is good, like average. The college campus is very good. It is a combination of three colleges, i.e., BBDU, BBDNIIT, and BBDNITM.

reviews.review_heading: In the year 2022, after lockdown, placements are as good as or better than in other years.
reviews.review_text: Hostel infrastructure is very good all over. Every class is fully furnished with all equipment and lighting funds. All labs are fully air conditioned, and tech labs have computer systems that are fully advanced and the latest version and configuration, all are working in good condition.

reviews.review_heading: The college is good, but exams are conducted so strictly.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi, labs, and classrooms are all decent and well-managed. Academically, it has been really great. All facilities are provided. A sports ground has been made, but it is not in use as of now. The ground is said to be used for football and cricket mainly. Mess food is a bit lower than okay and not much to be expected. It is okay for survival.

reviews.review_heading: Great infrastructure but a lack of smart faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good; Wi-Fi, labs, and classes are all decent and well managed. Academically, it has been great with all the facilities provided. A sports ground has been made, although it is not in use as of now, and the ground is said to be used for football and cricket mainly. Mess food is a bit lower than okayish; not much is to be expected, just okay for survival.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good campus life and an amazing fest.
reviews.review_text: The college has good campus life and a great ambiance. Wi-Fi is available. The classrooms are good, with fully air-conditioned and fully furnished. The stadium is available, and there are 2 canteens available separately. There is also a game zone. The food provided is good. The campus is neat and clean. All sports facilities are available.

reviews.review_heading: Honeslty, this college is not good. If you obey my words, then you can save your life.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure of the Babu Banarasi Das College are not good. Our classrooms are not cleaned. In summer, we suffer from heat because the fans are very slow, and no AC or cooler is provided in the classroom. Classroom quality is poor. The quality of the facilities in the hostel is not good. The quality of food is not good. Canteen is also in poor condition because it provides bad quality products, and there are no proper facilities in case of a medical emergency. College does n...

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and infrastructure with supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure for course & hostel (BBDITM) course facilities well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, high-speed Wi-Fi, central library with good resources. Hostel facilities are clean rooms, 24/7 electricity and water, decent mess food, canteen available, medical support, and sports facilities like basketball, badminton, and football.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, college is good for your study skills and placements.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure was too good. Hostel was also very good and food was decent on campus. There were many sports ground like cricket stadium, basketball court, and badminton area. Canteen mess was also good not too good but good.

reviews.review_heading: Heartfelt, absolutely great college because of the faculty, facilities, good placements, etc.
reviews.review_text: The Babu Banarsi Institute of Technology and Management features a large and impressive building infrastructure with high-quality facilities. Supportive faculty members provide significant help. The hostel facility in the college is excellent, as students expect.

reviews.review_heading: My journey at BBDNITM: A promising start.
reviews.review_text: There are no AC classrooms, and green boards are still in practice, but you will find a lush green campus. Canteens have good food. Library offers much space to study and better sports opportunities are available. There are required labs, and all are quite well-maintained. Hostels are much secure and well-maintained, offering good quality healthy food with maintained hygiene.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is very good. Fests and events are amazing here.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is the best part of this university. It has several colleges, a library, and a perfect classroom with fans and windows. There is Wi-Fi almost everywhere. I live in a campus hostel and the food is better than all the hostels out here. There is a basketball court, a stadium, and an air tennis court, as well as a temple. Overall, the infrastructure and hostel are good.

reviews.review_heading: This college and the college campus are very pleasant.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facilities on the campus are neat and clean.

reviews.review_heading: College is good but placements are very less which is important for students.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available but not for students. Labs are good and all equipment are also available related to the particular subjects. Classrooms and library are fine. Library environment is very good for studying. Hostels are not good to live because the charges are high.

reviews.review_heading: College and infrastructure are good.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is best in my college and campus surroundings and the atmosphere is also good for students and staff. The best thing is the rules and regulations are strict but this is good for maintaining the atmosphere of the community of college campus. BBD is best for program and culture.

reviews.review_heading: Very good university with average placements in 2025.
reviews.review_text: There is average infrastructure. We have good classrooms with whiteboards. There is a very good library with an AC. We have computer labs with i5 gen computers. Hostel facilities are also good with a good range. 1st year students have a separate hostel. Food quality is average and meals start from early morning to 8 PM. There are 4 times meals. Medical facilities are also provided. Every hostel has an indoor playing mini-stadium for badminton and basketball.
